errors.quote: There are $b+1$ rounds on prefix slots and $qK$ on chunks, $\ell$ in all.
errors.problem: The leading round at h=l-1 occurs only when some axis is long. With all axes short there are b prefix rounds and l-1 rounds in total. The paper says "at most b+1 <= K rounds on prefix slots" and "at most l rounds". The later phrase "the $\ell$ rounds leave error below" repeats the imprecision, though the bound still holds.
